package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Heartbeat records liveness of the verified machine.
func Heartbeat(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports HeartbeatPorts,
	in models.Beat,
) (models.Ack, error) {
	return ports.Registry.Beat(ctx, e, in)
}
